course_name: Certificate Course in Computer Hardware and Networking
objective: This course teaches newcomers the essentials of installing and troubleshooting PC hardware. On completion, participants will be able to install and configure PC hardware and system components, understand the basics of peripherals and local area networking, support and troubleshoot PC hardware, software, and peripherals, and apply customer service techniques.

This course uses a wide range of hands-on practical training to teach newcomers the essentials of installing and troubleshooting all types of PC hardware. It provides the foundational skills required for PC installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

The A+ certification course is an industry-standard certification for computer support engineers. It validates competence in installation, preventive maintenance, networking, security, and troubleshooting. It is globally recognized as a trusted indicator of qualified IT professionals and prepares entry-level candidates for IT support roles.

The N+ certification course provides a general introduction to computer networking, including local and wide area network technologies. It covers network architecture, topologies, protocols (especially TCP/IP), network operating systems, installation, upgrading, troubleshooting, user account management, security, remote access, and disaster recovery. It serves as a foundation for advanced vendor-specific networking certifications.

course_outline.module: Networking Topologies, Connectors, and Wiring Standards
IP Subnetting, Troubleshooting IP, and NAT

course_name: Diploma in CCTV and Security Systems
objective: This course helps learners understand the fundamental components of CCTV and security systems, including identification of malicious activity, fire alarm system zoning, and evaluation of detectors, beacons, and sounders used in security systems.

The objective of this course is to provide complete knowledge of CCTV system planning, design, specification, installation, setup, and maintenance of key components such as cameras, lenses, DVRs, NVRs, and cabling.

course_outline.module: Remote Monitoring through Phone and Internet

objective: This course provides fundamental knowledge of computer hardware and security systems. It focuses on access control, intrusion detection, fire alarm systems, and understanding methods, tools, and techniques used to prevent unauthorized access to physical and logical systems.

G-TEC Certified Cisco Network Associate (G-CCNA) validates the ability to install, configure, operate, and troubleshoot medium-sized routed and switched networks, including WAN connectivity. The course includes security fundamentals, wireless networking concepts, and introduces Cisco IOS and networking hardware.

G-TEC Certified Red Hat Engineer (G-CRHE) is a performance-based certification that measures real-world competency on live Linux systems. It validates the ability to configure networking services and security on servers running Red Hat-based operating systems and is considered an advanced Linux certification.

course_name: Certificate Course in Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking
objective: Cyber security involves technologies, processes, and practices designed to protect networks, computers, programs, and data from attack, damage, or unauthorized access. Ethical hacking focuses on identifying weaknesses in computer systems or networks to improve security and prevent exploitation.

A Certified Ethical Hacker is a skilled professional trained to identify vulnerabilities in target systems using the same tools and techniques as malicious hackers, but in a lawful and authorized manner. The certification validates expertise in assessing system security posture from a vendor-neutral perspective.

course_name: Certificate Course in Mobile Phone Technology
objective: This course is designed for students and professionals who want to build a career in mobile phone technology. It covers servicing of major smartphone brands, including fundamental hardware and software concepts.

course_outline.module: Parts and Their Functions in Mobile Phones

objective: Certified Network Defender (CND v2) is designed to help professionals actively protect digital business assets and detect and respond to cyber threats. The course focuses on network defense strategies, threat intelligence, and building comprehensive network security systems.

course_outline.module: Threat Assessment and Attack Surface Analysis

course_name: Certificate Course in Hardware and Software Installation
objective: This course provides hands-on practical training for newcomers in installing and troubleshooting PC hardware and software. It builds foundational skills required for PC support, focusing on installation, configuration, and basic troubleshooting.

This course provides hands-on practical training for newcomers in installing and troubleshooting PC software. It builds essential foundational skills required for PC support, focusing on software installation and basic troubleshooting.

The Ethical Hacking Associate (E|HA) certification demonstrates knowledge in information security and network security, including the tools and methodologies used by malicious hackers, but applied in a lawful and ethical manner. It establishes minimum standards for entry-level ethical hacking professionals and reinforces ethical hacking as a structured profession.

The Cyber Forensics Associate (C|FA) certification validates knowledge in detecting hacking attacks, extracting digital evidence, and conducting investigations to support legal proceedings. It prepares individuals to become part of incident response teams and helps in identifying intruder activities and preventing future cyber attacks.

This course trains beginners in Windows Server 2019/2022 administration, covering installation, Active Directory, networking, virtualization, security, PowerShell, and hybrid identity management using Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). It prepares learners for IT administrator roles with hands-on enterprise-level skills.

course_outline.module: Introduction to Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)

objective: This course is designed to provide foundational knowledge and practical skills in cybersecurity. It equips students with essential understanding of cybersecurity principles, techniques, and best practices to protect digital assets and mitigate cyber threats effectively.

This course equips individuals with essential skills to identify, exploit, and mitigate security vulnerabilities in computer systems, networks, and applications. It focuses on ethical hacking techniques used to simulate real-world cyber-attacks and assess an organization's security posture.

This course provides fundamental knowledge and practical skills in ethical hacking (penetration testing). It focuses on identifying and addressing vulnerabilities in computer systems, networks, and applications through authorized and legal methods as part of cybersecurity defense.

course_outline.module: Information Security Threats and Vulnerability Assessment
IoT and OT Attacks and Countermeasures

objective: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of fundamental concepts and techniques required to defend computer networks against cyber threats. It focuses on core principles of network security, controls, cryptography, and monitoring strategies.

The Certificate in Digital Forensics Essentials course provides fundamental knowledge and practical skills in digital forensics. It focuses on identifying, collecting, preserving, and analyzing digital evidence from computer systems, networks, and applications using lawful and structured investigation methods.

course_outline.module: Understanding Hard Disks and File Systems

course_name: Certificate Course in Dark Web and Anonymity
objective: This course provides a comprehensive exploration of the Dark Web, anonymity tools, and cryptocurrencies. It helps learners understand the technologies behind the Dark Web, methods for achieving online anonymity, and the role of cryptocurrencies in private transactions, along with legal, ethical, and societal implications.

course_outline.module: Introduction to the Dark Web and Anonymity
Exploring the Tor Network and Anonymity Tools
Legal and Ethical Considerations and Societal Implications

course_name: Certificate in Basic Hardware and Networking
objective: This introductory program equips students with foundational knowledge and skills in computer hardware and networking. It is designed for individuals seeking careers in IT support or network administration, covering system assembly, troubleshooting, and basic networking concepts with hands-on practice.
